card.name: Capitalized boxed warning headings
card.fires_on: Words inside ALL-CAPS boxed warning text, often a linking word or a partway-through word piece just before a key term such as neurotoxicity, allergens or dementia.

modes.label: Linking words in warning titles
modes.description: A small word such as WITH or BE in capitalized warning text, before the condition or action term.
modes.example: WARNING: INCREASED MORTALITY IN ELDERLY PATIENTS<< WITH>> DEMENTIA-RELATED PSYCH

modes.label: Inside capitalized long terms
modes.description: Partway through a long capitalized or hyphenated medical term, like ASSOCIATED or ALLERGENS.
modes.example: WARNING: CYTOKINE RELEASE SYNDROME AND IMMUNE EFFECTOR CELL-ASSOCI<<ATED>> NEUROTOXICITY SYND

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words for point, position and parameter, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of capitalized warning headings, where the next word of the title is still to come.
